releasenotes: The forum's front page for logged-in members up to 2000 times faster: on the forum we measured, the simplified forum view took 8 seconds for some members, every time; now 4 ms, the same topics in the same order (needs one index, added by the admin; the settings page shows the command). The leaderboard page no longer runs its slowest queries on every view (6.4 s + 2.6 s measured): results are kept for 5 to 60 minutes. Opening the notifications list no longer rewrites a member's whole notification history. The topic count of the simplified view is kept for 2 minutes. Fixed an IPS 4.7.25 bug that broke the preview of archived topics whose newest post is hidden. Each change has its own switch.
